# 086 — PR explainer: Browse tokens/chains live in the Defillama disclosure footer

## Goal

Human-reported bug: the footer "Browse tokens" / "Browse chains" links (added by item 045 to de-orphan
the SEO surface) were unclickable — permanently hidden under the "Powered by Defillama API" footer.
Directive: move them into that disclosure footer.

## Intuition

Two footers, two positioning models: `.app-footer` is position-fixed at the viewport bottom; the static
`.seo-hub-links` footer sits in normal flow at the very end of the document. A fixed element at the
viewport bottom covers the last in-flow element forever — the links rendered, but no scroll position
could ever expose them in analytics mode. The links users see must live inside the fixed footer; the
static anchors remain in the raw HTML because they're the crawler surface (045's purpose) and the
planner mode's only footer (no fixed footer exists there).

## What changed (reading order)

1. **app.js** — both `.app-footer` instances (main grid ~3009, pool-detail wrapper ~2486) gained a
   second line: `Browse tokens · Browse chains`, via new translation keys, honoring `?lang`. Existing
   `.app-footer a` styling reused.
2. **translations.js** — `browseTokens`/`browseChains`, EN + natural KO (토큰 둘러보기 / 체인 둘러보기).
3. **home.html (IA router)** — one added line stamps `data-app-mode` on `<html>` (mirrors the existing
   pre-paint `data-theme` pattern). The mode DECISION logic is untouched — same URLs resolve to the same
   modes; the attribute only reports the decision to CSS.
4. **style.css** — `html[data-app-mode="analytics"] .seo-hub-links { display: none }` (the static links
   hide only where their visible duplicates exist — same links for every audience, no cloaking) + a
   token-only margin class for the footer line.
5. **Static anchors preserved** — home.html raw markup still contains both `<a href="/tokens">` /
   `<a href="/chains">`; planner mode (no fixed footer) still shows them in flow, verified clickable.
6. **Artifacts** — app.compiled.js, app.compiled.min.js, translations.min.js, style.min.css
   regenerated, byte-idempotent.
7. **test_footer_hub_links.js (new, Playwright, fixture-routed, port 8803)** — analytics mode: links
   inside `.app-footer`, visible, real click navigates to `/tokens`, static footer hidden; planner mode:
   static links visible and clickable; KO strings render under `?lang=ko`; raw-HTML anchors asserted at
   the file level. Appended to the npm test chain.

## Deviations from spec

- Test flips `media="print"` async-CSS links to `media="all"` before asserting: headless Chromium's
  onload-swap for the pre-existing async-stylesheet pattern is unreliable in-sandbox, so the test forces
  the production cascade to apply rather than asserting against unstyled markup. The pattern itself
  predates this item.
